title: Sensex rises 390 points to 84,328.59 as IT stocks jump 3.66%, but more Nifty stocks fall than rise
short: Sensex +390, Nifty 25,884: IT jumps 3.66% in a narrow rally
dek: The Sensex gained 0.46% and the Nifty 0.25% to 25,884.50 after a volatile session. HCL Tech, TCS and Infosys led, while consumer and finance stocks fell and the rupee slipped to 92.44.
card: Nifty +65.25 at 25,884.50, Sensex +390.31 at 84,328.59. Nifty IT +3.66%, HCL Tech +6.42%, Asian Paints −2.98%. Rupee 92.44.
